title: Personal, Informative and Delicious!
text: Highly personalized tour. My husband and I thoroughly enjoyed the tour with Juliana. We met a lovely couple from NY who was also on the tour. Loved getting tips on places to eat and go and also found the tour interesting and informative. Ending at the restaurant and getting the unique recipe for Sangria was the perfect end and the tapas were delicious. Thx Juliana!! Highly recommend for personalized, touch, history/info and food.
author: Rene_T

title: An amazing start to a vacation of a life time
text: Very intimate and personalized  tour with Roberto.  Prompt pick up and he optimized the tour based on our interests as we progressed.  An amazing amount of information was packed into the two hours and we covered a lot of ground.  This week was Mercé festival and Roberto even got in a bunch of the history and events related to it.  We finished in an excellent restaurant with glass of sangria and we decided to stay for an incredible dinner.  We even went back on another night to try different items on the menu. title: Sabrina was fantastic...
text: Sabrina was fantastic guiding us around the Gothic Quarter and teaching us about the history of the place. She helped us with navigating the area and shared great tips and recommendations. I’m so glad we did this tour on our first day in Barcelona, and would recommend starting your trip the same way.
author: Colleen_P

title: We Love Juliana & Barcelona!
text: My sisters, mom and I had an amazing time with Juliana! She is so knowledgeable and passionate about history and about Barcelona! She became part of our family during our stay in Barcelona and made the experience so fun and memorable. Both the Gaudi and Gothic Quarter Tours  were interactive and interesting, and Juliana made them even more fun by making little games and quizzes to test our knowledge, while also showing us her favorite local secrets! I would definitely recommend doing a tour with Juliana. She is lovely and so sweet! I can’t wait to come back to Barcelona to see her again!
author: B5824ZSisabellad
